_about: Star sets and the ear/voice rules for every mode, as data (read by js/shared/stars.js; spec in docs/shared-api.md s3). rules.defaults apply to every mode; rules.<mode> changes only what differs; rules.<mode>.variants.<name> (a visit type, a mechanic) changes it again. Keys: earPass = share of tested rows that must be heard (1 = Cook's rule, the first miss loses the ear); minTested = fewer tested rows than this and the ear shows dashed, 'not tested this time'; taughtStage = rows whose word is at this stage or below are taught, not tested (stage 1 = first meeting); placeholdersTested = whether rows whose deciding word has no Kutchi yet count for the ear (no: an English placeholder is readable); voicePass / voiceMin = share of speaking moments that must be recognised or parent-ticked, and how many there must be; firstTry = only a first-try acceptance counts (the clinic); minConfidence = below this a recognition goes to the pills and doesn't count; busyWrongWeight = how much a wrong answer in Busy counts against the word's stage (1 = a full miss); lateCounts = whether a late answer (after the reveal) counts against the word's stage (never against its meaning in Monsoon); maxMissWeightPerRound = cap on one word's miss weight in one round (2 = at most one stage lost). star_sets are Cook's shape (data/cook.json star_sets) plus a 'voice' slot; icons are names in js/cook/ui.js ICON, or in Stars.ICONS for the new ones until the shell merges them.
